findings.message:
Reentrancy in WalletLibrary.confirm(bytes32) (../sb/parity_wallet_bug_2.sol#279-293):
	External calls:
	- ! m_txs[_h].to.call.value(m_txs[_h].value)(m_txs[_h].data) (../sb/parity_wallet_bug_2.sol#285)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- delete m_txs[_h] (../sb/parity_wallet_bug_2.sol#290)
	WalletLibrary.m_txs (../sb/parity_wallet_bug_2.sol#405) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- WalletLibrary.clearPending() (../sb/parity_wallet_bug_2.sol#369-380)
	- WalletLibrary.confirm(bytes32) (../sb/parity_wallet_bug_2.sol#279-293)
	- WalletLibrary.execute(address,uint256,bytes) (../sb/parity_wallet_bug_2.sol#241-266)
findings.name: reentrancy-eth
